newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - David Jones shares top turnover.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - David Jones shares top turnover.

text.p: Shares in retailer David Jones Ltd topped turnover in early trade on Tuesday with 10.01 million shares or about 2.6 percent of its capital traded.
Activity was thin, though, with the bulk of the trade in one line of 10 million shares specialled through ANZ Macaughan Securities at a price of A$1.66 per share.

Earlier, the company reported a year net profit of A$67.53 million, its first full year result since relisting on the Australian Stock Exchange in November 1995 after being spun off from the Adsteam Group.
A company spokesman said the trade in David Jones shares was part of a larger portfolio special sale.
"We have found out an that it is an institutional crossing involving not just David Jones shares. It's part of an institution's shuffling of their holdings," the spokesman told Reuters.
At 2.20 p.m. (0420 GMT), David Jones shares were steady at A$1.66 on turnover of 10.29 million shares.
